description: This file defines a React functional component 'ChatWindow' which manages a chat interface, including message handling, session management, and communication with a backend API. It incorporates message rendering, auto-scrolling, and user input handling.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending user messages to the backend API and updating the message list with the response.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in the textarea, sending the message on Enter key press (excluding Shift+Enter).
